XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Service light, oil light, "Check vehicle" and/or "Fault warning" warning
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: 73894 | 052129 | 922C64 | P052129 | PRESSURE | OIL | ENGINE | INJECTION | LEVEL | EXCHANGER | HEAT | RADIATOR | SERVICE | KEY | KEY | WARNING LIGHTS | 61193 |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• Applicability: Vehicles manufactured from 01/01/17 to 28/10/23

  • System: Fuel injection

  • Component: Water/oil heat exchanger module

  • Fault: Maintenance warning light illuminated; oil pressure warning light may also be illuminated; ‘Check vehicle’ and/or ‘Engine failure warning’ messages

  • Faults detected by the self-diagnostic system: One or more of the following:
    • 922C64: Oil pressure sensor circuit
    • 052129: Oil pressure sensor
    • P052129: Oil pressure switch value fault
  • Cause: Faulty earth point on the engine water/oil heat exchanger module

• Action: Check that the ground point on the heat exchanger is actually faulty, and then replace the water/engine oil heat exchanger.

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: New water/oil heat exchanger product code: 213050344R
